_note: Illustrated postcards used as starter rounds for Where in the World. Employee photos are added in the app.

seeds.label: Paris, France
seeds.hint: An iron lady stands over this river city.

seeds.label: Giza, Egypt
seeds.hint: Stone triangles older than almost anything else you can visit.

seeds.label: Sydney, Australia
seeds.hint: Sails on the harbor, a coat hanger bridge behind.

seeds.label: Mount Fuji, Japan
seeds.hint: A red gate, cherry blossoms, and a snow cap.

seeds.label: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
seeds.hint: Arms wide open over a sunny bay.

seeds.label: New York City, USA
seeds.hint: A spire in the skyline and a lady with a torch.

seeds.label: London, United Kingdom
seeds.hint: A famous clock, a red bus, and gray skies.

seeds.label: Grand Canyon, USA
seeds.hint: A river carved all of this, slowly.

seeds.label: Serengeti, Tanzania
seeds.hint: Flat-topped trees and very tall residents.

seeds.label: Reykjavik, Iceland
seeds.hint: The sky is the show. Bring a warm hat.

seeds.label: Machu Picchu, Peru
seeds.hint: Terraces carved into a cloud-level ridge.

seeds.label: Agra, India
seeds.hint: A white marble monument, perfectly mirrored.

seeds.label: Santorini, Greece
seeds.hint: White cubes and blue domes above a caldera.

seeds.label: Zermatt, Switzerland
seeds.hint: One famously pointy peak. Cows wear bells here.

seeds.label: Rome, Italy
seeds.hint: Gladiators once packed these arches.

seeds.label: Venice, Italy
seeds.hint: The streets are water. The taxis are boats.

seeds.label: Amsterdam, Netherlands
seeds.hint: Narrow gabled houses and more bikes than people.

seeds.label: Barcelona, Spain
seeds.hint: A basilica that has been under construction for over a century.

seeds.label: Moscow, Russia
seeds.hint: Colorful onion domes beside a famous red square.

seeds.label: Istanbul, Turkey
seeds.hint: A city that sits on two continents.

seeds.label: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
seeds.hint: The tallest building on Earth rises out of the desert.

seeds.label: Singapore
seeds.hint: A ship seems to sit on top of three towers.

seeds.label: Great Wall, China
seeds.hint: A wall that follows the ridgelines for thousands of miles.

seeds.label: Petra, Jordan
seeds.hint: A temple carved straight into rose-red cliffs.

seeds.label: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
seeds.hint: Five stone towers reflected in a moat at sunrise.

seeds.label: Cape Town, South Africa
seeds.hint: A flat-topped mountain wears a tablecloth of cloud.

seeds.label: San Francisco, USA
seeds.hint: A big orange bridge disappears into fog.

seeds.label: Niagara Falls, Canada and USA
seeds.hint: A roaring horseshoe of water on a national border.

seeds.label: Hawaii, USA
seeds.hint: A volcano meets a palm-lined beach.

seeds.label: Banff, Canada
seeds.hint: Turquoise glacier water under craggy peaks.

seeds.label: Chichén Itzá, Mexico
seeds.hint: A stepped pyramid built to track the sun.

seeds.label: Easter Island, Chile
seeds.hint: Hundreds of giant stone heads watch the ocean.

seeds.label: Stonehenge, United Kingdom
seeds.hint: Giant standing stones on a grassy plain.

seeds.label: Edinburgh, Scotland
seeds.hint: A castle on an extinct volcano, bagpipes included.

seeds.label: Great Barrier Reef, Australia
seeds.hint: You can see this living structure from space.

seeds.label: Antarctica
seeds.hint: Ice as far as you can see, and very formal residents.

seeds.label: Geirangerfjord, Norway
seeds.hint: A deep blue fjord with tiny red cabins.

seeds.label: Washington, DC, USA
seeds.hint: A tall white obelisk and a domed Capitol.

seeds.label: Detroit, Michigan, USA
seeds.hint: The Motor City skyline, with a cluster of round glass towers by the river.

seeds.label: Yellowstone, USA
seeds.hint: A geyser that erupts on a famously regular schedule.

seeds.label: Himalayas, Nepal
seeds.hint: The roof of the world, with prayer flags in the wind.

seeds.label: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
seeds.hint: Huts on stilts above water so clear you can see the fish.

seeds.label: Mount Kilimanjaro, Tanzania
seeds.hint: Africa’s tallest peak wears a snowy cap near the equator.
